description: Check a claim that a registrant (cik/company/accession) filed an 8-K carrying specific SEC item code(s) in a timeframe, against the filed record. Returns status=confirmed with the source filing(s) + link; not_found; partial (same registrant/filing but the claimed item(s) aren't carried, or the date differs — itemised claimed-vs-filed); out_of_scope (claims about the body's meaning/materiality aren't covered — the filing is never paraphrased); or out_of_coverage. Every response states the coverage window checked. Rule-2: item codes are the SEC controlled vocabulary parsed from the filing — never inferred from prose.

date.description: Claimed filing date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (matched ±3 filing days)

end.description: Window end (ISO) if the claim is a range

items.description: Claimed SEC 8-K item code(s), comma-separated (e.g. '5.02' or '1.01,9.01') — checked against the filing

start.description: Window start (ISO) if the claim is a range

name: verify_8k_event
title: Verify an 8-K disclosure claim against SEC Form 8-K
